notes: Gurugram is NOT included in NCRB's metropolitan-city tables (below 2M per Census 2011), so per-category city totals are stitched from Gurugram Police press summaries (Tribune India 'Looking Back 2022' + Oct-2023 theft tally). Concrete published 2022 figures: murder 88, attempt-to-murder 59, snatching 218, vehicle-theft 3523. Theft (4400) folds vehicle theft + snatching + other theft. Burglary (520) is ~60% of the 869 combined theft+burglary tally. Assault (150) ~= murder + attempt-to-murder. Sexual_offence, harassment, kidnapping, robbery, other are best-effort estimates from partial Tribune / Hindustan Times reporting; treat as calibration anchors not exact counts. Replace once Gurugram Police starts publishing a structured annual crime PDF.
